Expansion Materials Hub.reason: Colony foundation. Existing claim station should already be complete.
Industrial port support for construction-material trading; +1 T2.
Extraction support for raw-material economy; planner must satisfy its Extraction Settlement prerequisite first.
Additional Industrial Tier-1 port; +1 T2 and Industrial market support.
Tier-3 planetary port target once the system has enough T3 points.

Industrial Hub.reason: Additional Industrial Tier-1 port and +1 T2.
Industrial Hub target; Mining Outpost prerequisite is inserted automatically.

Mining and Refinery Hub.reason: Extraction Hub target; Extraction Settlement prerequisite is inserted automatically.

Research and Technology Hub.reason: Scientific planetary outpost; +1 T2 and High Tech market support.

Agricultural Hub.reason: Civilian Hub; Agricultural Settlement prerequisite is satisfied by the prior step.

Tourism Hub.reason: Satellite prerequisite for Tourism Settlements; +1 T2.
Tourism Settlement; costs 1 T2 and gives +1 T3.
Tourist Installation; requires a Tourism Settlement.

Colonisation Supply Network.reason: Industrial market support for manufactured construction goods and Food Cartridges.
Extraction support for raw construction materials; +1 T2.
Refinery support for processed metals and mining supply.
Agriculture support for local food supply; +1 T2.
High Tech market support for technology goods such as H.E. Suits; +1 T2.

buildout_stages.name: Industrial & Commodity Network
buildout_stages.description: Broaden industrial production, commodity trade, and mining support after the selected goals are secured.

buildout_stages.name: Mining & Refining Network
buildout_stages.description: Strengthen extraction, refining, and orbital mining support across the system.

buildout_stages.name: Science & Research Network
buildout_stages.description: Add scientific ports, research settlements, communications, and orbital research capability.

buildout_stages.name: Agriculture & Population Network
buildout_stages.description: Develop food, civilian, medical, and government support for a mature colony.

buildout_stages.name: Tourism & Services Network
buildout_stages.description: Add tourism, hospitality, and visitor-support infrastructure once core industry is established.

buildout_stages.name: Security & Military Network
buildout_stages.description: Build a layered military and security chain for a fully developed system.

buildout_stages.name: Exploration & Communications Network
buildout_stages.description: Improve system communications, exploration support, and distributed orbital coverage.

buildout_stages.name: Orbital Trade & Port Network
buildout_stages.description: Add useful orbital ports after supporting economies exist; expensive major ports remain late-stage choices.

buildout_stages.name: Independent Operations
buildout_stages.description: Optional late-stage independent/criminal infrastructure for commanders who want broad category coverage.
